content.title: Who Is RHORI Star Kelsy Swanson's Affluent Boyfriend? 23 Years Older To Her, Is A Father Of Three
content.text: The Real Housewives of Rhode Island is the brand-new addition to the Real Housewives universe. The show gives an insight into the personal and professional lives of a tight-knit circle of women living in Rhode Island. As per the show, it features eight women, with the spotlight falling on their friendship and family ties. The series promises oceanside dinners along with explosive arguments. Viewers would get a glimpse of infidelity, relationship drama, and competitive friendships followed by years of shared history. The cast of women promises a lot of entertainment to the viewers. Amid the ensemble cast, there is Kelsey Swanson, who is a beauty queen and lives in a castle set by her filthy rich boyfriend. Talking about Kelsey, she won Miss Rhode Island in 2017 and is now a top makeup artist. In the year 2014, she met with a car accident, and doctors found a non-cancerous tumour on her brain, which was later removed. Kelsey has been in a ten-year-long relationship with a man who is a notable figure in Rhode Island. Who is Kelsey Swanson dating? Kelsey Swanson is dating a man who is reportedly one of the most popular names in Rhode Island. Though she has not yet revealed the identity of the man, she calls their relationship ‘unorthodox’. In an interview, Kelsey revealed that she has been dating her boyfriend for ten years and has been open and honest with him. Kelsey Swanson met her boyfriend at a salon Speaking to Swoon, Kelsey shared details about her boyfriend, saying she met him at a tanning salon where her friend worked. The salon was owned by Kelsey’s boyfriend’s best friend. Kelsey met him at the salon to see her friend. Soon, at the salon owner's party, she met him again. Talking about the same, she shared: Continue reading below “I think we made out for two hours straight, and the rest was history. Maybe two months later, he was like, ‘Wanna go to London? Wanna go to Spain?’ And I’m like, ‘Sure!’ Been together ever since.” Kelsey Swanson’s boyfriend is 23 years older than him In the same interaction on Swoon, Kelsey talked about the significant age gap with her boyfriend and shared that he is 23 years older than she is. But she also mentioned that her boyfriend is well-groomed and is very handsome. In her words: “He’s very handsome. This isn’t some, like, I’m dating an old, disgusting man. He is very attractive. He takes care of himself. He’s active. He’s, like, 25 at heart.” Kelsey met her boyfriend when she was 20; while he was 43. The two had been together for ten years. Apart from being 23 years older than her, he is also a father of three. Kelsey revealed that out of his three children, two were three years younger than her. She also revealed sharing a comfortable bond with her boyfriend’s children and said: “One of them got married in September 2024, and I did her makeup for her wedding. We are totally fine. As they got older and I got older, it just grew normal, and they didn’t care.” What do you think about Kelsey Swanson’s relationship with her 23-year-old boyfriend?
